blockers.symptom: CutlassMLP SIMT GEMM livelocks on ivcore11 (100% GPU util, never completes even a 16->32x2->16 / batch=4096 inference in 300s). This is the matmul path tiny-cuda-nn uses once FullyFusedMLP is disabled.
blockers.final_verdict: Upstream NVIDIA CUTLASS SIMT GEMM is fundamentally incompatible with ivcore11: warpSize=64 (vs 32) breaks CUTLASS's hardcoded warp/thread tile geometry and shuffle-based reductions, ivcore11 lacks Volta+ Independent Thread Scheduling, and the whole NV 32-bit shared-address model is emulated. A correct high-performance GEMM here needs Iluvatar's own ixCUTLASS, which is out of scope (cannot modify /usr/local/corex, cannot re-derive CUTLASS warp tiling within this migration). Classified terminal.
blockers.error_snippet: test_networks: 'inference' and 'inference_mixed_precision' match -> SIGTERM (timeout) at test_common.h:153; GPU-Util 100%, no progress; ixgdb host stuck in sigsuspend.

attempts.action: Force CutlassMLP over FullyFusedMLP by setting MIN_GPU_ARCH=60 (disables NV-mma fully-fused path).
attempts.result: compiles; still uses upstream NV CUTLASS SIMT GEMM

attempts.action: Neutralize NV-only PTX in CUTLASS arch/memory.h + arch/memory_sm75.h (global/shared ld/st, ld.shared.v4.b32, 'l'/'h' constraints) with generic C++.
attempts.result: compiles + links (libtiny-cuda-nn.a builds); GEMM now launches

attempts.result: converted the hard deadlock (GPU-Util 0%) into a running kernel (GPU-Util 100%) but it livelocks

attempts.action: Reset GPU with 'ixsmi -i 1 -r' between runs to rule out driver residue; re-ran on a clean GPU.
attempts.result: reference.jpg (bilinear) + 'Beginning optimization' print, then CutlassMLP training step spins at 100% util with no Step#0 in 90s

blockers.symptom: FullyFusedMLP + JIT fusion require NV TensorCore wmma/mma PTX, compute capability >= 7.5 and IXRTC device-linking. ivcore11 reports cc=71 and provides none of the NV mma PTX; IXRTC cannot device-link the fused kernels.
blockers.final_verdict: TensorCore fully-fused / JIT-fused MLP is a hardware+toolchain terminal blocker on ivcore11; the library gracefully falls back to (attempted) CutlassMLP. Classified terminal (feature unavailable), but non-fatal to the build because it self-disables.
blockers.error_snippet: runtime: 'JIT: unsupported. Must use CUDA 11.8 and a GPU with compute capability 75 or higher, but got CUDA 13010 and compute capability 71.'

attempts.action: Set MIN_GPU_ARCH=60 so fully_fused MLP is compiled out and CutlassMLP is used instead.
Keep RTC enabled but rely on supports_jit_fusion()==false (cc<75) so JIT paths self-skip at runtime instead of invoking IXRTC.
attempts.result: JIT tests self-skip (test_jit_losses PASS); no IXRTC device-link attempted

attempts.action: Provide an ivcore11 shim returning the low 32 bits (the shared-window offset, matching NV cvta.to.shared semantics).
